payload.title: A site chooses who may edit its wiki
payload.description: Setting `wiki.editing` in `projection.json`: `editors` (Web 1.0, the default: pages of a publication), `members` (signed-in and granted membership), `readers` (anyone signed in). Decision proposed: build `editors` now on the wiki epic, and store the setting so the rest plug in; pages stay static either way, and edits reach them through a projection.
